title: Governed Resource Promotion Convergence
core_principle: PROMOTION IS A GOVERNED TRANSITION. DISCOVERY DOES NOT IMPLY REGISTRATION. REGISTRATION DOES NOT IMPLY ELIGIBILITY. ELIGIBILITY DOES NOT IMPLY AVAILABILITY.
primary_invariant: DISCOVERED != PROPOSED != APPROVED != REGISTERED != AVAILABLE != ELIGIBLE != SELECTED != AUTHORIZED != BOUND != ATTEMPTED != USED != VERIFIED

components.name: ResourcePromotionProposalService
components.responsibility: Creates typed proposals from discovery evidence. Proposals are immutable typed contracts. Cannot decide, approve, reject, register, authorize, invoke, or mutate RRM.

components.name: ResourcePromotionDecisionAuthority
components.responsibility: Makes typed decisions (APPROVE/REJECT) on proposals. Consumes decision IDs after use (single-use). Cannot propose, register, authorize, invoke, or mutate RRM.

components.name: CanonicalPromotionRegistrationBoundary
components.responsibility: Translates approved proposals into RRM registration. Performs 10-point TOCTOU revalidation before registration. Cannot propose, decide, authorize, or invoke.

components.name: CanonicalResourcePromotionService
components.responsibility: Orchestrates the full promotion lifecycle: propose -> decide -> register. Composes the three specialized services. No direct RRM mutation.

components.name: ResourcePromotionProposal
components.responsibility: Immutable typed proposal contract linking discovery evidence to a promotion request with scope and metadata.

components.name: ResourcePromotionDecision
components.responsibility: Immutable typed decision contract recording a typed approval/rejection of a proposal.

components.name: ResourcePromotionResult
components.responsibility: Immutable result record of a promotion attempt with success/failure status and reason.

toctou_checks: 9. No conflicting canonical resource in RRM
invariants: Approval alone never triggers registration (decision consumed at registration time)
Decision IDs are single-use (consumed after registration attempt)
Proposal IDs are deterministic from evidence identity
Providers cannot invoke themselves through promotion
